Question 1

Find the function f(x) and the value of b, given that ∫2bf(x)dx=limn→∞∑k=0n−1[(2+5kn)2⋅5n].

a
f(x)=(x+7)2 and b=7
b
f(x)=x2 and b=7
c
f(x)=(x+5)2 and b=5
d
f(x)=x2 and b=5
e
f(x)=(x+5)2 and b=7
